description: This file defines a Java class 'LoanPrincipalData' used to represent loan principal details, including disbursed, adjustments, paid, written off, and outstanding amounts. It also contains an internal MapStruct mapper interface for converting 'LoanSummary' domain objects into 'LoanPrincipalData' instances.

classes.name: LoanPrincipalData
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) for loan principal details, including disbursed, adjustments, paid, written off, and outstanding principal amounts.

classes.name: LoanPrincipalData.Mapper
classes.description: A MapStruct mapper interface for converting 'LoanSummary' objects to 'LoanPrincipalData' instances using specified field mappings.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts a 'LoanSummary' domain object into a 'LoanPrincipalData' DTO by mapping specific source fields to the DTO's fields.
